observed_structure: SIMDgroup lanes traverse a fixed-width input row and accumulate value-squared contributions in source-level float registers.
A simd_sum combines the lane contributions before the kernel divides by kHiddenSizeV1, adds params.rms_norm_eps, and applies rsqrt.
A layer-slot-adjusted base selects the normalization-weight row.
A second lane-strided loop reads each input element again and multiplies it by the inverse-RMS scalar and an input_norm_weight factor offset by 1.0 before writing the normalized buffer.
variant_notes: The cited kernel uses fixed kHiddenSizeV1 and lane-strided passes with simd_sum; the span does not establish the launch topology, row residency, or a general ownership contract.
The normalization-weight factor is input_norm_weight[layer_slot * kHiddenSizeV1 + column] + 1.0f rather than the direct factor used by the GDN variant.
The source-level second read does not establish a physical device-memory reread or any bandwidth result.
